title: 掩埋氣體抽取與利用~Landfill-gas extraction and use
focus: 建立掩埋甲烷生成、收集、氧化與利用的分流收支~Balance generated landfill methane among collection, oxidation and utilization
summary: 本課以「建立掩埋甲烷生成、收集、氧化與利用的分流收支」為主軸，依序處理有機物庫存與可分解部分、收集與表面逸散、集氣風機能量、甲烷能量利用、井網監測與資料缺口。十個單元各包含機制、算例、量測驗證及失效診斷；數值均為明示的原創教學假設，不能直接用作工程設計、排放限值或設備設定。~This course focuses on Balance generated landfill methane among collection, oxidation and utilization, progressing through Organic inventory and degradable fraction, Collection and surface escape, Gas-collection blower energy, Methane energy utilization, Well-network monitoring gaps. Ten units each address mechanism, worked calculation, measurement verification and failure diagnosis. Numbers are explicit original teaching assumptions, not design values, emission limits or equipment settings.
history: 這項技術的學習脈絡由單一設備處理，逐步擴展至物質與能量收支、監測品質和生命週期比較。本課將官方方法文件作為查核入口，並以獨立編寫的假想數據練習；參考文件的年代與地區不代表其規範在所有場址適用。~The learning progression expands from individual treatment equipment to mass and energy balances, monitoring quality and lifecycle comparison. Official method documents provide verification starting points while independently authored hypothetical data support practice; a document date or jurisdiction does not establish applicability to every site.

units.title: 有機物庫存與可分解部分~Organic inventory and degradable fraction
units.mechanism: 掩埋垃圾的可分解部分隨組成而異，總噸數不能直接代表氣體潛力。 分率必須以同一濕基或乾基定義；總質量乘分率才是該成分的質量。~Degradable content varies with waste composition; total tonnage alone does not establish gas potential. Fractions require a consistent wet or dry basis; multiplying total mass by its fraction gives component mass.
units.model: 原創教學假設，非現場操作值：總進料 m=1000 kg；目標成分質量分率 f=0.18。公式 m_target=m*f，計算得 180 kg。適用邊界：批次均勻且分樣具代表性；不把質量分率當體積分率。~Original teaching assumptions, not field operating values: Total feed m=1000 kg; target-component mass fraction f=0.18. Formula m_target=m*f gives 180 kg. Applicability: A homogeneous batch and representative sampling; mass fraction is not volume fraction.
units.verify: 針對「有機物庫存與可分解部分」，秤總樣與分離後成分，保存含水率與分樣方式，檢查回收率。 保存原始資料、單位與校正日期，以本步模型和另一種可能原因比較。~For Organic inventory and degradable fraction, Weigh the bulk sample and separated fraction; retain moisture basis and sampling procedure and check recovery. Retain raw data, units and calibration date; compare the model with one alternative explanation.
units.failure: 濕基與乾基混用會令回收物或負荷被高估。 在「有機物庫存與可分解部分」的流程圖圈出錯誤可能進入的位置，再指定能區分原因的量測。~Mixing wet and dry bases overstates recovered material or loading. Mark where this error can enter the Organic inventory and degradable fraction flow and name a measurement that distinguishes causes.
units.misconception: 相同百分比不論濕基或乾基都代表相同質量。~The same percentage gives the same mass on wet and dry bases.
units.practice: 只將 f 改成 0.22，其餘輸入固定。重算結果應由 180 變成 220 kg。先預測方向，再核對單位與假設；用離線模擬或已提供資料完成，不操作現場設備。~Change only f to 0.22, holding all other inputs fixed. Recalculation changes 180 to 220 kg. Predict the direction first, then check units and assumptions; use offline simulation or supplied data without operating field equipment.

units.title: 生成速率與時間演變~Generation rate over time
units.mechanism: 以一階模型比較反應速度假設，明確保留多批次投入與含水差異未被解析。 一階模型讓轉換速率與當下濃度成正比，對數濃度對時間近直線。~Compare rate assumptions in a first-order model while noting unresolved multiple waste cohorts and moisture differences. A first-order model makes conversion rate proportional to current concentration; log concentration is approximately linear in time.
units.model: 原創教學假設，非現場操作值：初始量 C0=100 mg/L；假設一階常數 k=0.10 d⁻¹；時間 t=10 d。公式 C=C0*exp(-k*t)，計算得 36.7879 mg/L。適用邊界：固定環境與可利用性、無新污染源；不能外推成真實完工日期。~Original teaching assumptions, not field operating values: Initial C0=100 mg/L; assumed first-order rate k=0.10 d⁻¹; time t=10 d. Formula C=C0*exp(-k*t) gives 36.7879 mg/L. Applicability: Constant environment and availability with no new source; this does not predict a real completion date.
units.verify: 針對「生成速率與時間演變」，用多時點數據擬合並保留未參與擬合的點，檢查尾端是否偏離一階趨勢。 保存原始資料、單位與校正日期，以本步模型和另一種可能原因比較。~For Generation rate over time, Fit multiple time points, hold some out and inspect late-time deviations from first-order behaviour. Retain raw data, units and calibration date; compare the model with one alternative explanation.
units.failure: 吸附、傳質或持續源項可造成拖尾，不能只調 k 強行吻合。 在「生成速率與時間演變」的流程圖圈出錯誤可能進入的位置，再指定能區分原因的量測。~Sorption, mass transfer or ongoing sources can cause tailing; changing k alone may hide the mechanism. Mark where this error can enter the Generation rate over time flow and name a measurement that distinguishes causes.
units.misconception: 前兩點符合一階衰減就保證所有後續時間也符合。~Agreement with two early points guarantees first-order decay at all later times.
units.practice: 只將 k 改成 0.07 d⁻¹，其餘輸入固定。重算結果應由 36.7879 變成 49.6585 mg/L。先預測方向，再核對單位與假設；用離線模擬或已提供資料完成，不操作現場設備。~Change only k to 0.07 d⁻¹, holding all other inputs fixed. Recalculation changes 36.7879 to 49.6585 mg/L. Predict the direction first, then check units and assumptions; use offline simulation or supplied data without operating field equipment.

units.title: 收集與表面逸散~Collection and surface escape
units.mechanism: 抽氣井回收的量只是生成量的一部分，覆土氧化與未收集逸散需分帳。 收集、覆土氧化與逸散分屬不同通量；氧化率應作用於剩餘通量而非總量重複扣除。~Well collection is only part of generation; account separately for cover oxidation and uncollected escape. Collection, cover oxidation and escape are separate fluxes; oxidation acts on the remaining flux rather than being subtracted twice.
units.model: 原創教學假設，非現場操作值：生成甲烷 G=100 m³/h；假設收集率 c=0.70；氧化率 o=0.10（僅作用於未收集部分）。公式 escape=G*(1-c)*(1-o)，計算得 27 m³ CH₄/h。適用邊界：假想均勻平均率，不代表掩埋場實測或法定排放係數。~Original teaching assumptions, not field operating values: Generated methane G=100 m³/h; assumed collection c=0.70; oxidation o=0.10 applied only to uncollected gas. Formula escape=G*(1-c)*(1-o) gives 27 m³ CH₄/h. Applicability: Hypothetical uniform mean rates, not field observations or regulatory emission factors.
units.verify: 針對「收集與表面逸散」，把收集流量、表面通量與氣體組成併看，保留不可量測項的不確定度。 保存原始資料、單位與校正日期，以本步模型和另一種可能原因比較。~For Collection and surface escape, Combine collected flow, surface flux and gas composition while retaining uncertainty in unmeasured terms. Retain raw data, units and calibration date; compare the model with one alternative explanation.
units.failure: 只從抽氣量反推生成量會把假定收集效率當成觀測。 在「收集與表面逸散」的流程圖圈出錯誤可能進入的位置，再指定能區分原因的量測。~Inferring generation from collected gas alone turns an assumed efficiency into an apparent observation. Mark where this error can enter the Collection and surface escape flow and name a measurement that distinguishes causes.
units.misconception: 抽到的氣體量就是掩埋場產生的全部氣體量。~Collected gas equals all gas generated by the landfill.
units.practice: 只將 c 改成 0.80，其餘輸入固定。重算結果應由 27 變成 17 m³ CH₄/h。先預測方向，再核對單位與假設；用離線模擬或已提供資料完成，不操作現場設備。~Change only collection c to 0.80, holding all other inputs fixed. Recalculation changes 27 to 17 m³ CH₄/h. Predict the direction first, then check units and assumptions; use offline simulation or supplied data without operating field equipment.

units.title: 抽氣壓差與空氣侵入~Extraction pressure and air intrusion
units.mechanism: 過度負壓可能吸入空氣並改變氣質；讀值需和氧及甲烷組成一起看。 差壓反映測點間總阻力，須配合同時的流量與氣體狀態判讀。~Excess suction can draw air and alter gas quality; interpret pressure with oxygen and methane composition. Differential pressure reflects resistance between taps and needs concurrent flow and gas-condition data.
units.model: 原創教學假設，非現場操作值：量測前壓 p1=1800 Pa；後壓 p2=600 Pa。公式 dp=p1-p2，計算得 1200 Pa。適用邊界：相同基準壓力與測點；單一差壓不能區分所有堵塞或洩漏原因。~Original teaching assumptions, not field operating values: Upstream pressure p1=1800 Pa; downstream pressure p2=600 Pa. Formula dp=p1-p2 gives 1200 Pa. Applicability: Common pressure reference and specified taps; one differential cannot identify every blockage or leak.
units.verify: 針對「抽氣壓差與空氣侵入」，檢查導壓管、零點和測點位置，再把差壓與流量趨勢一起畫出。 保存原始資料、單位與校正日期，以本步模型和另一種可能原因比較。~For Extraction pressure and air intrusion, Inspect impulse lines, zero and tap locations, then plot pressure drop with flow. Retain raw data, units and calibration date; compare the model with one alternative explanation.
units.failure: 導壓管堵塞可能被誤判為設備阻塞。 在「抽氣壓差與空氣侵入」的流程圖圈出錯誤可能進入的位置，再指定能區分原因的量測。~A blocked impulse line can be mistaken for equipment blockage. Mark where this error can enter the Extraction pressure and air intrusion flow and name a measurement that distinguishes causes.
units.misconception: 只要差壓上升，就能確定濾材一定破損。~A higher differential pressure proves the filter medium is damaged.
units.practice: 只將 p1 改成 2200 Pa，其餘輸入固定。重算結果應由 1200 變成 1600 Pa。先預測方向，再核對單位與假設；用離線模擬或已提供資料完成，不操作現場設備。~Change only p1 to 2200 Pa, holding all other inputs fixed. Recalculation changes 1200 to 1600 Pa. Predict the direction first, then check units and assumptions; use offline simulation or supplied data without operating field equipment.

units.title: 集氣風機能量~Gas-collection blower energy
units.mechanism: 管網阻力、冷凝液與井數影響風機需求，增加功率不保證增加有效甲烷回收。 風機軸功率近似流量乘壓升再除效率；阻力增加時不能假設風量與效率都不受影響。~Network resistance, condensate and well count affect blower duty; more power does not guarantee more effective methane recovery. Fan shaft power is approximately flow times pressure rise divided by efficiency; increasing resistance may also change flow and efficiency.
units.model: 原創教學假設，非現場操作值：風量 Q=1.5 m³/s；壓升 Δp=1200 Pa；假設效率 η=0.60。公式 P=Q*dp/eta/1000，計算得 3 kW。適用邊界：不可壓縮、固定效率的比較，不是風機曲線選型。~Original teaching assumptions, not field operating values: Airflow Q=1.5 m³/s; pressure rise Δp=1200 Pa; assumed efficiency η=0.60. Formula P=Q*dp/eta/1000 gives 3 kW. Applicability: An incompressible fixed-efficiency comparison, not fan-curve selection.
units.verify: 針對「集氣風機能量」，量測風量、差壓與輸入功率，在同一運轉點核對效率。 保存原始資料、單位與校正日期，以本步模型和另一種可能原因比較。~For Gas-collection blower energy, Measure airflow, differential pressure and input power at the same operating point. Retain raw data, units and calibration date; compare the model with one alternative explanation.
units.failure: 堵塞使壓降上升，若只提高風機轉速可能增加能耗而不解決配流。 在「集氣風機能量」的流程圖圈出錯誤可能進入的位置，再指定能區分原因的量測。~Blockage raises pressure drop; speed increases may waste energy without correcting distribution. Mark where this error can enter the Gas-collection blower energy flow and name a measurement that distinguishes causes.
units.misconception: 風機功率只與風量有關，與管路阻力無關。~Fan power depends only on flow and not on duct resistance.
units.practice: 只將 Δp 改成 1800 Pa，其餘輸入固定。重算結果應由 3 變成 4.5 kW。先預測方向，再核對單位與假設；用離線模擬或已提供資料完成，不操作現場設備。~Change only Δp to 1800 Pa, holding all other inputs fixed. Recalculation changes 3 to 4.5 kW. Predict the direction first, then check units and assumptions; use offline simulation or supplied data without operating field equipment.

units.title: 氣體污染物負荷~Gas-contaminant loading
units.mechanism: 氣體中的硫化物或其他雜質需按氣量和濃度估負荷，才能比較淨化需求。 氣體污染質量流率須用同一標準溫壓與乾濕基的氣量、濃度相乘。~Estimate impurity loading from gas volume and concentration before comparing conditioning requirements. Gas pollutant mass rate requires flow and concentration at the same reference conditions and moisture basis.
units.model: 原創教學假設，非現場操作值：乾標準氣量 Q=10000 Nm³/h；濃度 C=20 mg/Nm³。公式 m=Q*C/1e6，計算得 0.2 kg/h。適用邊界：Nm³ 的定義需另註明；本題比較固定基準，未套用氧校正。~Original teaching assumptions, not field operating values: Dry standard gas flow Q=10000 Nm³/h; concentration C=20 mg/Nm³. Formula m=Q*C/1e6 gives 0.2 kg/h. Applicability: Define the normal-volume reference; this comparison fixes that basis and applies no oxygen correction.
units.verify: 針對「氣體污染物負荷」，查驗溫壓、含濕率及濃度報表欄位，再核對煙道流速與面積。 保存原始資料、單位與校正日期，以本步模型和另一種可能原因比較。~For Gas-contaminant loading, Check temperature, pressure, moisture and concentration-report bases, then verify duct velocity and area. Retain raw data, units and calibration date; compare the model with one alternative explanation.
units.failure: 標準氣量和實際體積流量混乘會系統性偏差。 在「氣體污染物負荷」的流程圖圈出錯誤可能進入的位置，再指定能區分原因的量測。~Multiplying standard concentration by actual volume flow creates systematic bias. Mark where this error can enter the Gas-contaminant loading flow and name a measurement that distinguishes causes.
units.misconception: 任何單位標成 m³ 的氣量都可直接乘 Nm³ 基準濃度。~Any flow labelled m³ can directly multiply a concentration based on Nm³.
units.practice: 只將 Q 改成 12000 Nm³/h，其餘輸入固定。重算結果應由 0.2 變成 0.24 kg/h。先預測方向，再核對單位與假設；用離線模擬或已提供資料完成，不操作現場設備。~Change only Q to 12000 Nm³/h, holding all other inputs fixed. Recalculation changes 0.2 to 0.24 kg/h. Predict the direction first, then check units and assumptions; use offline simulation or supplied data without operating field equipment.

units.title: 甲烷能量利用~Methane energy utilization
units.mechanism: 以甲烷而非總掩埋氣計算化學能，並保留發電或直接用熱的不同邊界。 化學能乘轉換效率得到毛發電量，再扣輔助用電才是淨輸出。~Calculate chemical energy from methane rather than total landfill gas and distinguish electricity from direct heat use. Chemical energy multiplied by conversion efficiency gives gross generation; subtract auxiliary demand for net export.
units.model: 原創教學假設，非現場操作值：甲烷流量 q=90 m³/d；低位熱值 H=35.8 MJ/m³；假設電效率 η=0.32。公式 E=q*H*eta/3.6，計算得 286.4 kWh/d。適用邊界：定常氣質與固定效率；未計停機和輔機，用電效率不能超過 1。~Original teaching assumptions, not field operating values: Methane q=90 m³/d; lower heating value H=35.8 MJ/m³; assumed electrical efficiency η=0.32. Formula E=q*H*eta/3.6 gives 286.4 kWh/d. Applicability: Constant gas quality and efficiency; downtime and auxiliaries are omitted and electrical efficiency cannot exceed one.
units.verify: 針對「甲烷能量利用」，以氣量、甲烷分析及電表對讀，分開列出總發電與輔機耗電。 保存原始資料、單位與校正日期，以本步模型和另一種可能原因比較。~For Methane energy utilization, Cross-check gas volume, methane analysis and electric meters; list gross generation and auxiliaries separately. Retain raw data, units and calibration date; compare the model with one alternative explanation.
units.failure: 把熱效率與電效率相加後套在發電，會重複計算。 在「甲烷能量利用」的流程圖圈出錯誤可能進入的位置，再指定能區分原因的量測。~Applying combined thermal and electrical efficiency to electricity alone double-counts output. Mark where this error can enter the Methane energy utilization flow and name a measurement that distinguishes causes.
units.misconception: 回收的所有熱能都已經轉成可輸出的電力。~All recovered heat has already become exportable electricity.
units.practice: 只將 η 改成 0.28，其餘輸入固定。重算結果應由 286.4 變成 250.6 kWh/d。先預測方向，再核對單位與假設；用離線模擬或已提供資料完成，不操作現場設備。~Change only η to 0.28, holding all other inputs fixed. Recalculation changes 286.4 to 250.6 kWh/d. Predict the direction first, then check units and assumptions; use offline simulation or supplied data without operating field equipment.

units.title: 淨能量與自用電~Net energy and internal electricity
units.mechanism: 收集、淨化與發電輔機都應進入能量帳，避免只展示發電機毛輸出。 淨輸出必須扣除系統內輔機；邊界決定哪些用電應納入。~Include collection, conditioning and generator auxiliaries rather than showing gross generator output alone. Net output subtracts internal auxiliaries; the chosen system boundary determines which loads belong in the account.
units.model: 原創教學假設，非現場操作值：毛發電 Eg=1200 kWh/d；風機 Ef=160 kWh/d；泵 Ep=90 kWh/d。公式 Enet=Eg-Ef-Ep，計算得 950 kWh/d。適用邊界：同一日與同一電表邊界，未計外購熱和建造能耗。~Original teaching assumptions, not field operating values: Gross generation Eg=1200 kWh/d; fans Ef=160 kWh/d; pumps Ep=90 kWh/d. Formula Enet=Eg-Ef-Ep gives 950 kWh/d. Applicability: Same day and metering boundary; purchased heat and embodied construction energy are excluded.
units.verify: 針對「淨能量與自用電」，用分表與主表核對電量和，避免把外部用戶用電算作設備損失。 保存原始資料、單位與校正日期，以本步模型和另一種可能原因比較。~For Net energy and internal electricity, Reconcile submeters with the main meter and avoid charging external users to equipment losses. Retain raw data, units and calibration date; compare the model with one alternative explanation.
units.failure: 只報毛發電會掩蓋高阻力、低效率輔機的影響。 在「淨能量與自用電」的流程圖圈出錯誤可能進入的位置，再指定能區分原因的量測。~Reporting gross generation hides energy penalties from high-resistance, inefficient auxiliaries. Mark where this error can enter the Net energy and internal electricity flow and name a measurement that distinguishes causes.
units.misconception: 毛發電量就是可售出的淨電量。~Gross generation equals net electricity available for export.
units.practice: 只將 Ef 改成 220 kWh/d，其餘輸入固定。重算結果應由 950 變成 890 kWh/d。先預測方向，再核對單位與假設；用離線模擬或已提供資料完成，不操作現場設備。~Change only Ef to 220 kWh/d, holding all other inputs fixed. Recalculation changes 950 to 890 kWh/d. Predict the direction first, then check units and assumptions; use offline simulation or supplied data without operating field equipment.

units.title: 井網監測與資料缺口~Well-network monitoring gaps
units.mechanism: 井況與氣體成分隨空間改變，失聯井不能以鄰井數值無標示取代。 完整率追蹤有效資料覆蓋；缺值可能集中在尖峰事件，不能只看比例。~Well condition and gas composition vary spatially; do not silently substitute neighboring values for missing wells. Completeness tracks valid coverage; gaps may cluster during peaks, so percentage alone is insufficient.
units.model: 原創教學假設，非現場操作值：應有時段 N=1440；有效時段 n=1320。公式 coverage=n/N*100，計算得 91.6667 %。適用邊界：明確時間格與有效性規則；本題不宣稱任何法規有效率門檻。~Original teaching assumptions, not field operating values: Expected intervals N=1440; valid intervals n=1320. Formula coverage=n/N*100 gives 91.6667 %. Applicability: Explicit interval grid and validity rules; no regulatory completeness threshold is claimed.
units.verify: 針對「井網監測與資料缺口」，畫出缺值時間軸並保留校正、維護與通訊錯誤旗標，禁止把缺值填成零。 保存原始資料、單位與校正日期，以本步模型和另一種可能原因比較。~For Well-network monitoring gaps, Plot missing intervals with calibration, maintenance and communication flags; never replace missing values with zero. Retain raw data, units and calibration date; compare the model with one alternative explanation.
units.failure: 高污染時停機造成選擇性缺值，可偏低估平均污染。 在「井網監測與資料缺口」的流程圖圈出錯誤可能進入的位置，再指定能區分原因的量測。~Outages during high pollution cause selective missingness and can bias the average downward. Mark where this error can enter the Well-network monitoring gaps flow and name a measurement that distinguishes causes.
units.misconception: 缺測資料填成零不會影響污染平均值。~Replacing missing data with zero does not affect mean pollution.
units.practice: 只將 n 改成 1200，其餘輸入固定。重算結果應由 91.6667 變成 83.3333 %。先預測方向，再核對單位與假設；用離線模擬或已提供資料完成，不操作現場設備。~Change only valid intervals n to 1200, holding all other inputs fixed. Recalculation changes 91.6667 to 83.3333 %. Predict the direction first, then check units and assumptions; use offline simulation or supplied data without operating field equipment.

units.title: 停機情境與氣體去向~Outages and gas disposition
units.mechanism: 在數位流程中比較利用設備停機時的替代處理邊界，記錄各通量而非假設氣體停止生成。 可用率描述指定期間能工作的時間比例，並不等於合格產出率。~Compare alternative handling boundaries when utilization equipment is offline; log fluxes rather than assuming generation stops. Availability is the working-time fraction over a specified period, not the compliant-output fraction.
units.model: 原創教學假設，非現場操作值：總計畫時數 T=1000 h；停機 t=60 h。公式 availability=(T-t)/T*100，計算得 94 %。適用邊界：明確定義計畫時間與停機分類；未納入性能降額或品質不合格。~Original teaching assumptions, not field operating values: Scheduled time T=1000 h; downtime t=60 h. Formula availability=(T-t)/T*100 gives 94 %. Applicability: Defined scheduled time and downtime categories; derating and rejected output are excluded.
units.verify: 針對「停機情境與氣體去向」，對照事件紀錄、備援切換和品質資料，分開統計不可用及不合格時間。 保存原始資料、單位與校正日期，以本步模型和另一種可能原因比較。~For Outages and gas disposition, Compare event logs, backup switching and quality data, separating unavailable and nonconforming periods. Retain raw data, units and calibration date; compare the model with one alternative explanation.
units.failure: 設備在線但數據失效或處理不合格時，不能當作完整有效服務。 在「停機情境與氣體去向」的流程圖圈出錯誤可能進入的位置，再指定能區分原因的量測。~An online unit with invalid data or nonconforming treatment is not fully effective service. Mark where this error can enter the Outages and gas disposition flow and name a measurement that distinguishes causes.
units.misconception: 可用率 100% 就能保證所有產出或量測都合格。~One hundred percent availability guarantees all output and measurements conform.
units.practice: 只將 t 改成 90 h，其餘輸入固定。重算結果應由 94 變成 91 %。先預測方向，再核對單位與假設；用離線模擬或已提供資料完成，不操作現場設備。~Change only downtime to 90 h, holding all other inputs fixed. Recalculation changes 94 to 91 %. Predict the direction first, then check units and assumptions; use offline simulation or supplied data without operating field equipment.
